details: The U.S. Senate has once again postponed the vote on the Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act (H.R. 3633) until September 2026, failing to pass the crypto market-structure legislation before its August recess. The delay stems from ongoing disagreements between Republicans and Democrats over key provisions, including financial-crime measures, stablecoin regulations, and ethics rules concerning public officials' crypto holdings. This continued delay prolongs regulatory uncertainty for the cryptocurrency industry in the United States.
title: US Senate Delays CLARITY Act Vote to September

details: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is scheduled to release the Consumer Price Index (CPI) for July 2026 on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time. This upcoming report will provide crucial insights into inflation trends, which are a primary factor influencing the Federal Reserve's monetary policy decisions. The CPI measures changes in what American consumers pay for a fixed basket of goods and services, and its results are closely watched by financial markets.
sourceName: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (information sourced from various financial news outlets reporting on the BLS schedule)
title: US July CPI Data Release Scheduled for August 12

details: Tensions between the United States and Iran in the Strait of Hormuz continue to be a significant geopolitical concern, with ongoing diplomatic efforts aimed at de-escalation. U.S. President Donald Trump indicated the U.S. was "low keying it" with Iran, following a halt in military offensives to allow for Omani-mediated talks regarding the reopening of the crucial shipping lane. While Iran has denied direct talks with the U.S., it has confirmed discussions with Oman. This persistent geopolitical instability can impact global oil prices and overall market risk sentiment.
sourceName: Reuters (as widely reported by major financial news outlets)
title: US-Iran Standoff Persists, Diplomatic Efforts Continue
